name: mesomelic dysplasia, Savarirayan type
description: Mesomelic dysplasia, Savarirayan type is characterized by severely hypoplastic and triangular-shaped tibiae, and absence of the fibulae. So far, two sporadic cases have been described. Moderate mesomelia of the upper limbs, proximal widening of the ulnas, pelvic anomalies and marked bilateral glenoid hypoplasia were also reported.
